subject: Focus decision: same-generation terminal presentation readiness gate
body: DISCOVERY_COMPLETE=YES; CANDIDATES_CONSIDERED=7; TOP_CANDIDATE=C1 terminal presentation readiness/first-current-frame handoff; TOP_SCORE=24; RUNNER_UP_1=C7 topology-epoch route fencing/15; RUNNER_UP_2=C6 early-prewake reversal cleanup/15; SELECTED_GAP_TYPE=IMPLEMENTATION_GAP+LIFECYCLE_GAP+OBSERVABILITY_GAP+TEST_GAP; SELECTED_GAP_STATEMENT=current continuity can advance terminal handoff from route/topology activity without a same-generation, same-target, current-content presentation receipt; WHY_SELECTED_NOW=current source directly confirms the gap, primary mesh leaves terminal readiness open, and a decisive pure model is locally testable without duplicating active sensor work; KNOWN_OVERLAP=Agents03/04/05/08 established power!=route!=presentation but did not close receipt semantics; INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=presentation gate/model and instrumentation contract only; CHEAPEST_DECISIVE_FIRST_ACTION=prototype a pure receipt gate keyed by transition generation, target logical id/topology epoch and content generation, then adversarially reject stale/wrong-route/wrong-generation receipts.
